title: Console nav drawer takes 300–580 ms to open on the showcase at CPU 4x (46 entries); profile and bring it under 200 ms
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from the #29075 audit (phone-width Navigation flow, run record `/mnt/project-files/issue-29075/run-record-before.md`) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** On a mid-range phone, tapping the menu button should show the menu at once. On an app with many entries it lags noticeably, so the Console feels slow on the screen people use most.

**Measured (`origin/main` `6b3ba82c`, real Console, DevTools CPU throttle 4x, step 16; time from click to the first painted frame).** Showcase (46 entries): drawer open `[294,349,576]` and `[377,431,347]` ms. CRM: `[253,107,109]` ms. Group toggle 173 to 252 ms; drawer scroll is fine. Three of the four runs FAIL a 200 ms budget.

**Wanted.**
1. Profile the drawer open (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` and what it mounts) and name what costs the time.
2. At CPU 4x, drawer open is under 200 ms on the showcase, and the group toggle is under 200 ms.
3. No change in what the drawer shows.

**Tests.** A render-count or timing guard where it is stable. The run record method, repeated after the fix, is the acceptance.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`area:navigation`, performance). Size M. Serialize after #29075, which edits `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`.

**Dedupe.** Searched `drawer open performance sidebar`: no product card.

Links back: #29075, #29040.
